Recruiter.Title: CRM System Development
Recruiter.Description: Design and develop a CRM system to manage up to 30,000 LinkedIn contacts, enabling sorting by industry, role level, and geographic region, integrating NLP for data categorization and personalized communication.

User Stories.Title: Profile Categorization Using NLP
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the CRM system to categorize LinkedIn profiles using NLP by industry, role level, and geographic region, so that I can efficiently organize and target my outreach.
AcceptanceCriteria: Profiles must be accurately categorized into pre-defined industry categories.
Profiles must be sorted by role level (e.g., entry-level, mid-level, senior).
Profiles must be categorized by their geographic location.
The categorization process should handle up to 30,000 profiles without degradation in performance.

User Stories.Title: Manual Review and Approval of Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to manually review, edit, and approve personalized messages before they are sent, so that I can ensure each message is tailored and appropriate for the recipient.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system provides an interface to review each message.
Recruiters can edit messages in real-time.
Recruiters can approve or reject messages.
Changes are updated in real-time within the system.

User Stories.Title: Sorting and Filtering Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to filter and sort contacts within the CRM by industry, role level, and geographic region, so that I can easily find and communicate with the most relevant contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contacts can be filtered by multiple categories: industry, role level, and geographic region.
The UI supports sorting operations with minimal latency.
The system updates the UI in real-time to reflect filters and sorting preferences.

User Stories.Title: Integration with OpenAI for Data Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to integrate the CRM with OpenAI API for enhanced data analysis, so that I can leverage advanced NLP techniques for better profiling and communication strategies.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with OpenAI API is established without errors.
Data sent to and received from OpenAI API is correctly formatted as required.
The system leverages the OpenAI API for real-time data analysis when categorizing profiles.

User Stories.Title: Local Data Management
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to manage the contact data locally using simple storage solutions like Google Sheets or JSON, so that I can have control and direct access to my data without complex database systems.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data can be stored and retrieved from Google Sheets or JSON formats.
No data corruption occurs during read/write operations.
Data handling operations must support up to 30,000 contacts.

User Stories.Title: User Interface for Message Review
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want a simple yet functional UI designed to facilitate the review and approval process of messages, using layouts like photo cards, so that I can efficiently manage communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: The UI displays messages in a row format like photo cards.
Each message card includes options to approve, reject, and edit.
Each card displays the contact's user name and role.
Real-time updates in the UI as edits are made to the messages.

Recruiter.Title: Profile Analysis and Personalization
Recruiter.Description: Implement functionality to analyze LinkedIn profiles using OpenAI API to categorize contacts and personalize messages based on industry, role, and region, ensuring relevant and targeted communications.

User Stories.Title: Profile Categorization Using NLP
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to analyze LinkedIn profiles using NLP to categorize contacts by industry, role, and region, so that I can efficiently organize my outreach efforts.
AcceptanceCriteria: System pulls data from LinkedIn profiles correctly.
Profiles are categorized by industry, role, and region with an accuracy rate of at least 90%.
Categories are viewable and editable in the CRM interface.

User Stories.Title: Personalized Messaging
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to send personalized messages based on the categorized data, so that my communications are more relevant and targeted.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages can be personalized based on industry, role, and region.
System allows for previewing messages before sending.
Messages incorporate contact’s name and specific details relevant to their profile for personalization.

User Stories.Title: Manual Review and Approval of Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the ability to review and approve or edit messages before they are sent, to ensure accuracy and appropriateness of the message content.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can approve or reject messages individually.
Editing tool is available for real-time modification of message content.
System updates the message in real-time following any edits.

User Stories.Title: Contact Filtering
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to filter contacts by industry, role, and region within the CRM, so that I can target specific groups more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contacts can be filtered by multiple criteria: industry, role, and region.
The filtering process is intuitive and quick.
Filtered results are displayed immediately and can be saved for future use.

User Stories.Title: Daily Messaging Limit
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to enforce a limit of sending no more than 30 personalized messages per day, to comply with LinkedIn’s usage policies and maintain system integrity.
AcceptanceCriteria: System tracks the number of messages sent per day.
Alerts user when the daily limit of 30 messages is reached.
Prevents sending more than the set limit of messages.

User Stories.Title: Local Data Management
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to manage contact data locally using either Google Sheets or JSON structures, so that I have control over my data and its security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data is stored locally and can be accessed via Google Sheets or a JSON structured file.
No data is lost or corrupted when stored locally.
User can easily export or import data as needed.

Recruiter.Title: Message Review and Approval Interface
Recruiter.Description: Create a user interface using Plasma that allows the recruiter to review, approve, or reject personalized messages in a photo card layout, with real-time editing capabilities to ensure message accuracy before sending.

User Stories.Title: View Messages in Photo Card Layout
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to view personalized messages in a photo card layout so that I can easily navigate through them and make decisions efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages are displayed in a photo card layout.
Each card includes the contact's name, role, and the personalized message.
Cards are visually distinct and spaced appropriately.

User Stories.Title: Approve or Reject Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to approve or reject messages directly from the photo card interface so that I can quickly process messages to be sent.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each message card has 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons.
Clicking 'Approve' sends the message to the queue for dispatch.
Clicking 'Reject' removes the message from the dispatch queue.
The system confirms the action with a brief notification on the UI.

User Stories.Title: Edit Messages in Real-Time
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the ability to edit messages directly in the photo card layout so that I can ensure the accuracy and appropriateness of the content before sending.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each message card includes an editable text field.
Changes in the text field are updated in real-time.
The UI provides an intuitive and responsive text editing experience.
There is a 'Save' button for changes which confirms the edit.

User Stories.Title: Identification on Message Cards
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want each message card to display the LinkedIn contact's name and role so that I can ensure the message is personalized appropriately before sending.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each card displays the contact's name and role prominently.
The information is pulled accurately from the CRM system.
Updates in CRM reflect immediately on the message cards.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time UI Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the user interface to update in real-time when I edit, approve, or reject messages to ensure that my changes are captured instantly and accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: UI updates reflect instantly without needing to refresh the page.
Actions such as approve, reject, or edit result in immediate visual feedback.
There should be no lag or delay in the UI response.

Recruiter.Title: Local Data Management
Recruiter.Description: Develop a solution for managing LinkedIn contact data locally using Google Sheets or JSON structures, ensuring easy access and manipulation of contact data without complex security measures.

User Stories.Title: Import LinkedIn Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to import LinkedIn contact data into Google Sheets or JSON structures, so that I can manage contacts locally and efficiently without relying on internet connectivity.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system is able to import contacts from LinkedIn using the recruiter's credentials.
Data such as name, role, company, and contact information is accurately pulled and organized.
Contacts are stored in either Google Sheets or a JSON structure based on user preference.
The import process must handle up to 30,000 contacts.

User Stories.Title: Filter Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to filter contacts by industry, role, and region, so that I can target specific groups for outreach campaigns.
AcceptanceCriteria: The user interface allows filtering of contacts by industry, role level, and geographic region.
Filters can be applied and removed dynamically.
Filtered views are updated in real-time to reflect changes.

User Stories.Title: Edit Contact Information
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the ability to edit contact information directly within the local database, so that I can keep contact details up-to-date easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can edit details like name, role, company, and contact information within the Google Sheets or JSON structure.
Changes are saved in real-time and users can undo recent changes if needed.
The system ensures data integrity during edits.

User Stories.Title: Export Filtered Lists
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to export filtered lists of contacts into Excel or CSV formats, so that I can use them for reports or external marketing tools.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows exporting of contact data filtered by specified criteria.
Exported files are in .csv or .xls format as chosen by the user.
The export process ensures that no data formatting is lost or corrupted.

User Stories.Title: Secure Local Data Access
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to ensure that my local data access is secure to prevent unauthorized access, even without complex security measures.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows setup of simple, password-based access controls for the local database.
Access logs are maintained for monitoring who accessed the data and when.
The system alerts the user of any unauthorized access attempts.

Recruiter.Title: Multi-threading for Performance Optimization
Recruiter.Description: Implement multi-threading capabilities to enhance system performance, allowing up to 10 concurrent threads to handle operations without overloading the local system, focusing on maintaining human-like interactions.

User Stories.Title: Thread Management for User Request Handling
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to manage up to 10 concurrent threads efficiently when handling user requests so that the system remains responsive and stable without overwhelming the local system.
AcceptanceCriteria: System should not exceed 10 concurrent threads at any time.
Each thread must handle a separate user request.
System performance should not degrade as threads increase from 1 to 10.
Threads should be monitored and logged for performance analysis.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Multi-Threading Error Handling
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to implement real-time error handling in a multi-threading environment so that potential issues can be quickly identified and addressed without disrupting user activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time error detection and logging for each thread.
System should provide notifications or alerts for errors within threads.
Error recovery measures should be in place to prevent system crash or data loss.
Documentation of common errors and troubleshooting steps should be available.

User Stories.Title: Thread Allocation for Data Processing
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to allocate threads for data processing tasks so that contact management operations (like sorting and filtering) are performed efficiently and without delays.
AcceptanceCriteria: Threads should be dynamically allocated based on the complexity and number of operations.
Data processing tasks should be completed within predefined time limits.
System should balance load across threads to optimize resource use.
Feedback on data processing status should be provided to the user.

User Stories.Title: User Interface Responsiveness
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the user interface to remain responsive and update in real-time, even when multiple threads are active, so that I can efficiently review, approve, or edit messages without delays.
AcceptanceCriteria: UI updates reflect changes in real-time.
Performance metrics are maintained with up to 10 active threads.
UI should allow for interruption and resumption of work without data loss.
Users should not experience freezing or crashing of the UI.

User Stories.Title: Thread-Safe Logging System
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the system to have a thread-safe logging mechanism so that operations from multiple threads are recorded accurately for audit trails and performance tracking.
AcceptanceCriteria: Logs should include timestamps, thread identifiers, and action details.
Logging system must handle simultaneous entries from multiple threads without data corruption.
Logs should be searchable and support filtering by thread, date, and type of action.
Log files should be automatically backed up and protected from accidental deletion.

Recruiter.Title: Logging and Monitoring
Recruiter.Description: Establish a logging mechanism for each function within the software to track operations and performance, particularly in multi-threaded environments, ensuring reliability and aiding in troubleshooting.

User Stories.Title: Implement Basic Logging Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want each function of the software to have basic logging capabilities so that I can track operations and ensure each component is functioning correctly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each function in the system writes operation logs to a file.
Logs must include timestamps, function names, and status messages.
Logs can be accessed and read directly from a local file.

User Stories.Title: Detailed Error Logging
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want detailed error logging within the software so that I can easily identify and troubleshoot issues, particularly in multi-threaded operations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Errors and exceptions are logged with detailed information, including the error type, message, and stack trace.
Error logs are separate from operation logs for easier monitoring.
All multi-threaded operations have thread-specific log entries.

User Stories.Title: Log File Management
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want the software to manage log files effectively so that they are easy to access, read, and do not consume excessive disk space.
AcceptanceCriteria: Log files are rotated daily.
Old log files are archived after 30 days.
System alerts the user if the log file size exceeds a predefined threshold.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Logging View
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to view logs in real-time through the user interface so that I can monitor the system’s operations interactively and identify issues promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provide a UI section to display real-time logs.
Logs in the UI should refresh automatically without user intervention.
The user can filter logs by type (error, operation) and severity within the UI.

User Stories.Title: Logging Configurability
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want to configure the detail level of logs so that I can adjust the verbosity based on current needs, optimizing for performance or detailed tracking.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system allows the user to select log levels (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).
Changing log levels can be done via the UI without needing to restart the system.
Configuration changes are applied in real-time and affect subsequent logging.

Recruiter.Title: Unit Testing for System Verification
Recruiter.Description: Define and implement unit tests for each function of the system to ensure all components work as intended, prioritizing reliability and correctness in the software's operations.

User Stories.Title: User Story 1: Unit Test for Profile Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want unit tests for the profile analysis function so that I can ensure the system accurately categorizes LinkedIn profiles by industry, role level, and region.
AcceptanceCriteria: Unit test confirms that the profile analysis function categorizes profiles correctly.
Test handles various profile data inputs and outputs correct categorization.
All tests should pass with no errors in the function's logic.

User Stories.Title: User Story 2: Unit Test for Message Sending Function
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want unit tests for the message sending function so that I can verify the system correctly formats and sends personalized messages without errors.
AcceptanceCriteria: Unit test verifies that messages are personalized based on the recipient's profile data.
Test ensures messages adhere to set limits (no more than 30 messages per day).
Check that the system handles network failures gracefully.

User Stories.Title: User Story 3: Unit Test for Data Management
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want unit tests for local data management functionality so that I can be confident in the system's ability to store and retrieve contact data accurately and efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Test checks that data is correctly saved and retrieved from local storage solutions like Google Sheets or JSON structures.
Ensure data integrity and no data loss during operations.
Functional validation of data sorting and filtering capabilities.

User Stories.Title: User Story 4: Unit Test for User Interface Interactions
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want unit tests for the user interface interactions, particularly for message approval and editing, to ensure the interface responds correctly in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Test to confirm real-time updates in message editing work flawlessly.
Ensure all UI elements such as buttons and edit fields function as intended.
UI should correctly display changes without any lags or errors.

User Stories.Title: User Story 5: Unit Test for NLP Processing
User Stories.Description: As a Recruiter, I want unit tests for the NLP processing function to ensure that the system accurately interprets and classifies text from LinkedIn profiles using the OpenAI API.
AcceptanceCriteria: Verify that NLP processing correctly identifies key terms like industry and role level.
Ensure that errors and exceptions from the OpenAI API are handled appropriately.
Check system's ability to update classification rules based on new data inputs.

Sales Representative.Title: CRM Development for LinkedIn Outreach
Sales Representative.Description: Develop a CRM system that integrates with the user's LinkedIn account to manage and analyze up to 30,000 contacts. This system should include functionalities to categorize contacts by industry, role, and geographic region using NLP techniques.

User Stories.Title: Contact Categorization by Industry
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the CRM system to categorize LinkedIn contacts by industry using NLP techniques so that I can easily target industry-specific campaigns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contacts must be automatically categorized into predefined industry segments.
The system must use NLP to analyze the contact's profile and determine the appropriate industry.
The categorization process should handle up to 30,000 contacts without degradation in performance.

User Stories.Title: Contact Categorization by Role
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the CRM system to categorize LinkedIn contacts by role level within their company using NLP techniques so that I can tailor my communication based on the seniority of the contact.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contacts must be automatically categorized by job title into role levels such as junior, mid-level, and senior.
NLP analysis must be used to interpret job titles from profiles and categorize accordingly.
The system should provide an option to review and adjust the categorization manually if necessary.

User Stories.Title: Geographic Filtering of Contacts
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to filter contacts by geographic region so that I can organize local or region-specific outreach campaigns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contacts should be filterable by geographic region based on the location information available on their LinkedIn profiles.
The CRM must provide a user-friendly interface to select regions for filtering.
Filtered views of contacts should be savable and retrievable for future use.

User Stories.Title: Profile Analysis for Message Personalization
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the CRM to analyze LinkedIn profiles and use this analysis to help personalize messages so that my communication is relevant and engaging.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must analyze key elements of a LinkedIn profile using NLP to suggest personalized message content.
Users should be able to manually edit suggested messages before sending.
The CRM should store message templates which can be quickly adapted based on the analytics.

User Stories.Title: Approval and Editing of Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to be able to review, approve, or reject messages that the CRM system prepares for sending so that I can ensure all communications meet my standards before going out.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must provide an interface displaying messages in a row format, akin to photo cards, with options to approve, reject, or edit messages.
Edits should update in real-time within the system.
The system should allow saving and revisiting drafts before final approval.

Sales Representative.Title: Message Management System
Sales Representative.Description: Implement a system that allows the user to send up to 30 personalized messages daily to LinkedIn contacts, with functionality for users to manually review, edit, and approve each message before sending.

User Stories.Title: User Profile Analysis Integration
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to automatically analyze LinkedIn profiles and categorize them by industry, role level, and geographic region, so that I can target my messaging more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Profiles must be categorized into predefined industry categories.
Profiles must be categorized by role level within their company.
Profiles must be categorized by geographic region.
The system must use NLP techniques for analyzing and categorizing profiles.
The categorization results must be visible and editable in the CRM system.

User Stories.Title: Manual Message Review and Approval
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to manually review, edit, and approve or reject messages before they are sent, so that I can ensure the content is appropriate and personalized.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must display messages in a row format similar to photo cards.
Each message card must display the user's name and role.
Each message card must include options to approve, reject, and edit the message.
Edits to messages must update in real-time.
Approved messages are queued for sending.

User Stories.Title: Daily Messaging Limit Control
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to enforce a limit of sending up to 30 personalized messages per day, so that I can comply with LinkedIn's usage policies and avoid spamming.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must track the number of messages sent per day.
Messages must not exceed the 30 messages per day limit.
Users should be alerted when the daily limit has been reached.
The system should prevent any more messages from being sent once the daily limit is reached until the next day.

User Stories.Title: Contact Filtering and Sorting
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to filter and sort contacts based on industry, role, and region, so that I can easily find and message the most relevant contacts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users must be able to filter contacts by industry, role level, and geographic region.
Contacts must be sortable by the same criteria.
The filtering and sorting interface should be intuitive and easy to use.
Filtered and sorted results should be immediately visible in the CRM system.

User Stories.Title: CRM Integration
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to integrate with a CRM tool that manages my contacts, so that I can maintain an organized database of my LinkedIn network.
AcceptanceCriteria: The CRM should display contact information clearly.
The CRM must allow manual entry and editing of contact details.
Contacts should be automatically added to the CRM post-analysis.
The CRM should provide functionalities to note follow-up tasks (though reminders are not needed at this stage).
The CRM should be capable of handling up to 30,000 contacts.

Sales Representative.Title: User Interface for Message Review
Sales Representative.Description: Design and implement a user interface using Plasma that displays messages in a photocards-like format with options to approve, edit, or reject messages in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Display Photocards of Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to view messages in a photocards-like format so that I can easily navigate through them and make quick decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages must be displayed in a grid layout resembling photocards.
Each card must clearly display the message content, sender’s name, and date sent.
The user interface must be responsive and adapt to different screen sizes.

User Stories.Title: Approve or Reject Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to have approve and reject buttons for each message so that I can easily manage messages directly from the photocards interface.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each message card must have 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons.
Clicking 'Approve' sends the message, clicking 'Reject' discards the message.
The system must confirm the action with a temporary notification on the interface.

User Stories.Title: Edit Messages
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want an edit option on each message card so that I can make quick modifications before sending them.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each message card must include an 'Edit' button.
Clicking 'Edit' should open a text field within the card for message modification.
Changes must be saved in real-time as specified by the user.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the message edits to update in real-time so that I can ensure all changes are immediately reflected and saved without manual intervention.
AcceptanceCriteria: Any edit made to a message must reflect immediately on the interface.
The system should auto-save these changes instantly without requiring a save button.
Ensure there is no lag or performance issues during real-time updates.

User Stories.Title: User Information Display
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want each message card to display the LinkedIn contact’s name and role so that I can personalize my review process more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each message card must display the contact's name and current role prominently.
The information should be pulled directly from the LinkedIn profile data stored in the system.
Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of the displayed information.

Sales Representative.Title: Local Data Management
Sales Representative.Description: Create a system to manage data locally using Google Sheets or JSON structures, ensuring easy access and manipulation of data without the need for advanced security measures.

User Stories.Title: Data Import to Local System
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to import LinkedIn contact data into Google Sheets or JSON structures so that I can manage my contacts locally without relying on external CRM systems.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data can be imported directly from LinkedIn to the local system as Google Sheets or JSON.
Data integrity must be maintained during the import process.
The import process should handle up to 30,000 contacts efficiently.

User Stories.Title: Data Sorting and Filtering
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to sort and filter contacts by industry, role level, and geographic region using the local data management system so that I can target my communication more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Contacts can be filtered by industry, role level, and geographic region.
The system provides a user-friendly interface for sorting and filtering.
Changes in sorting and filtering preferences should reflect immediately.

User Stories.Title: Manual Data Editing Capability
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the ability to manually edit contact information in the local system so that I can correct errors and update contact details as needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can edit contact details such as name, industry, role level, and region within the local system.
Edited data should save automatically and reflect in real-time.
The system should provide an undo option to revert changes if necessary.

User Stories.Title: Data Backup and Export
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to backup and export the contact data from the local system so that I can ensure data safety and use the data in other applications if necessary.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data can be backed up locally at user-defined intervals.
Users can export data as CSV or JSON files.
The system should confirm the successful backup and export of data.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Data Synchronization
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want real-time synchronization of my local data with any changes made during the day so that I can ensure all my records are up to date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Any changes in the local data records are reflected in real-time.
The system should handle simultaneous updates efficiently without data loss.
Users receive notifications or visual indicators when data synchronization is in process or completed.

Sales Representative.Title: System Performance Optimization
Sales Representative.Description: Ensure the system operates efficiently on local machines using multi-threading with up to 10 threads, focusing on quality and human-like interactions without the use of external automation tools like Selenium.

User Stories.Title: Thread Management for Multi-threading
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to efficiently manage up to 10 threads so that multiple tasks can be executed simultaneously without overloading the system, ensuring smooth and fast operations.
AcceptanceCriteria: System must support up to 10 threads concurrently.
Thread management must prevent system overload.
Performance metrics must demonstrate system efficiency with multi-threading enabled.

User Stories.Title: Real-time Message Editing
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to edit messages in real-time so that I can ensure all communications sent out are accurate and tailored to the recipient's profile, enhancing personalization and effectiveness.
AcceptanceCriteria: Editing interface must update changes in real-time.
Each message must allow for immediate, on-the-fly modifications before sending.
The system must save changes automatically without manual interventions.

User Stories.Title: Human-like Browsing Simulation
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to simulate human-like interactions with LinkedIn without using tools like Selenium or Puppeteer so that the outreach activities remain under LinkedIn's acceptable use policy and avoid detection as automated bots.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must interact with LinkedIn using a method that mimics human browsing behaviors.
No use of Selenium, Puppeteer, or similar tools.
System must pass checks that confirm interactions are perceived as human-operated within LinkedIn.

User Stories.Title: Local Data Management
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want to manage LinkedIn contact data locally using Google Sheets or JSON so that I can easily access and manipulate data without the need for complex databases or cloud storage, ensuring quick access and control.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data can be stored and retrieved from Google Sheets or JSON formats.
The system must ensure data integrity and prevent data loss during operations.
Performance benchmarks for data retrieval and storage must meet predefined standards.

User Stories.Title: UI for Message Review
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want a user-friendly interface that displays messages like photo cards with options to approve, reject, or edit, so that I can conveniently review and decide on the final communication, ensuring that it aligns with my outreach strategy.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages must be displayed in a row format like photo cards.
Each card must have 'approve', 'reject', and 'edit' options.
User interactions with the UI must be logged and trackable.

User Stories.Title: CRM Integration and Profile Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to automatically categorize LinkedIn profiles by industry, role level, and geographic region using NLP so that I can target communications more effectively and manage contacts efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: System must use NLP to analyze and categorize LinkedIn profiles.
Contacts must be sortable by industry, role level, and geographic region within the CRM.
Accuracy of categorization must be 95% or higher.

Sales Representative.Title: Logging and Monitoring
Sales Representative.Description: Develop a logging mechanism that tracks each function's performance and interactions, especially under multi-threading operations, to ensure system reliability and facilitate debugging.

User Stories.Title: Log Creation for Function Execution
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want each function within the CRM system to generate a log entry upon execution so that I can trace any issues or delays in the system's operations, particularly when handling LinkedIn interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: A log entry is created every time a function is executed.
The log includes timestamp, function name, and outcome (success or error).
Logs are stored in a local file accessible to the user.

User Stories.Title: Performance Metrics Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want the system to track and log performance metrics of each function, especially under multi-threading conditions, so that we can ensure optimal operation and identify potential areas for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Performance metrics such as execution time and memory usage are recorded for each function.
Metrics are logged and linked with function execution logs.
Critical performance thresholds are defined, and alerts are logged if these are exceeded.

User Stories.Title: Error Logging and Notification
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want all system errors during multi-threading operations to be logged with detailed diagnostic information so that the technical team can quickly address and resolve these issues.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each error encountered during the multi-threading operations must be logged.
Error logs should include error type, timestamp, and stack trace.
Errors that impact system performance or data integrity should trigger a notification to the system administrator.

User Stories.Title: User Interface for Log Access
User Stories.Description: As a Sales Representative, I want an easy-to-use interface to access and search through logs so that I can quickly find specific entries related to function performance or errors without needing technical assistance.
AcceptanceCriteria: A user interface module within the CRM allows for searching, filtering, and viewing logs.
Users can filter logs by date, function, or error type.
The interface provides options to download or archive logs for external analysis.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Logging for User Actions

Business Professional.Title: Performance Optimization
Business Professional.Description: Incorporate multi-threading to optimize system performance, allowing up to 10 threads simultaneously without overloading the local system, ensuring efficient operation under the specified local hardware constraints.

User Stories.Title: Implement Multi-threading Capability
User Stories.Description: As a Business Professional, I want the system to utilize multi-threading to handle multiple operations concurrently, so that the CRM system can process data without slowing down or freezing the local system.
AcceptanceCriteria: System must be able to launch up to 10 threads simultaneously.

Performance tests should confirm that the system does not overload when running 10 threads at the same time.

User Stories.Title: Thread Management Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Business Professional, I want a dashboard to monitor and manage the threads, so that I can ensure they are functioning correctly and adjust their operations as needed without technical assistance.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows current active threads and their tasks.
Users can manually pause, stop, or restart threads from the dashboard.
System provides real-time feedback on the health and performance of each thread.

User Stories.Title: Dynamic Thread Allocation
User Stories.Description: As a Business Professional, I want the system to dynamically allocate threads based on the workload, so that it can maximize efficiency and prevent system overload.
AcceptanceCriteria: System evaluates workload and automatically adjusts the number of active threads.

User Stories.Title: Thread Efficiency Analytics
User Stories.Description: As a Business Professional, I want to receive analytics reports on thread efficiency, so that I can understand system performance and identify potential areas for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: System generates weekly reports detailing thread usage, efficiency, and any performance bottlenecks.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling in Multi-threaded Environment
User Stories.Description: As a Business Professional, I want comprehensive error handling mechanisms within the multi-threaded operations, so that any issues can be quickly identified and resolved without affecting the overall system performance.
AcceptanceCriteria: System logs all errors related to threading operations.

Recovery procedures are in place to restart or reroute tasks as necessary with minimal downtime.

Business Professional.Title: System Logging and Monitoring

AcceptanceCriteria: Logging is enabled for each thread within multi-threaded processes.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Log Update Feature
